title: Conormal sheaf of the diagonal
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $\Delta:X\to X\times_S X$ its diagonal [def-pc-base-change]. Define $\mathcal K=\ker(\mathcal O_{X\times_S X}\to\Delta_*\mathcal O_X)$ as a sheaf of modules. The diagonal conormal sheaf is $C_\Delta=\Delta^*\mathcal K$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. On every open neighbourhood $W$ of $\Delta(X)$ where the diagonal is closed, $\mathcal K|_W$ is its ideal $\mathcal I$, so $C_\Delta$ is canonically $\Delta^*(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2)$, independently of $W$.
